bigTokens.unit: next tokens scored (1,000 windows of the validation split)

bigPpl0.unit: perplexity of the fp32 model on those tokens

pplAll8t.unit: perplexity, every linear weight matrix int8 per tensor

klAll8t.unit: mean KL(fp32 || int8 per tensor) per position, nats

agreeAll8t.unit: share of positions whose top-1 token matches fp32
